scenes.name: The real Wizard: ask, timelapse, check

narration.en: Our data is spread across portals like ASAP, GSCM, BDP and NERP, each packed with reports.
narration.spoken: Our data is spread across portals like ASAP, GSCM, BDP and N-ERP, each packed with reports.

narration.en: And then there are endless Excel files, emails, presentations and PDFs.
narration.spoken: And then there are endless Excel files, emails, presentations and PDFs.

narration.en: Finding one answer means knowing where to look, then opening report after report, and piecing it together by hand.
narration.spoken: Finding one answer means knowing where to look, then opening report after report, and piecing it together by hand.

narration.en: Meet Wizard. It brings every source together, in one place.
narration.spoken: Meet Wizard. It brings every source together, in one place.

narration.en: Wizard's local AI has learned our portals, so it knows where every answer lives.
narration.spoken: Wizard's local AI has learned our portals, so it knows where every answer lives.

narration.en: So you can simply ask, in plain words.
narration.spoken: So you can simply ask, in plain words.

narration.en: Wizard finds the right reports for you: sell-out from GSCM, market share from ASAP, spend from NERP, and your targets in Excel.
narration.spoken: Wizard finds the right reports for you: sell-out from GSCM, market share from ASAP, spend from N-ERP, and your targets in Excel.

narration.en: Seconds later, you have a complete answer: a clear summary, the key numbers, and charts you can share.
narration.spoken: Seconds later, you have a complete answer: a clear summary, the key numbers, and charts you can share.

narration.en: Every number is checked against its source report, so you can trust it.
narration.spoken: Every number is checked against its source report, so you can trust it.

narration.en: And your data stays safe, with authorized AI that only shows what you're allowed to see.
narration.spoken: And your data stays safe, with authorized AI that only shows what you're allowed to see.
